reply.text:
I'm glad you said it, and I'm not going to skip past it. Thinking everyone would be better off without you is serious, and it matters more than today's session.

Please talk to someone right now. If you're in the US, you can call or text 988, the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, any hour. If you're elsewhere, tell me where and I'll help you find the right number, or contact your local emergency services. If you might act on these thoughts, call emergency services now. If you can, tell someone near you how you've been feeling too.

I'm a coach, not a counselor, so I can't give you what a person trained for this can. I'm here, though, and the training will wait. How are you doing right now?
